bibliographic-data.invention-title: VERFAHREN ZUR HERSTELLUNG EINES CELLULOSEPRODUKTS, VORRICHTUNG ZUR FORMUNG EINES CELLULOSEPRODUKTS UND CELLULOSEPRODUKT
PROCÉDÉ DE FABRICATION D'UN PRODUIT CELLULOSIQUE, APPAREIL DE FORMATION DE PRODUIT CELLULOSIQUE ET PRODUIT CELLULOSIQUE
METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING A CELLULOSE PRODUCT, CELLULOSE PRODUCT FORMING APPARATUS AND CELLULOSE PRODUCT

abstract.p: A method for manufacturing a cellulose product, comprising the steps: dry forming a cellulose blank in a dry forming unit; arranging the cellulose blank in a forming mould; heating the cellulose blank to a forming temperature in the range of 100°C to 200°C; and pressing the cellulose blank in the forming mould with a forming pressure of at least 1 MPa.
